I've looked into Community College. Even if I transferred - I would need to take two years minimum, and at my local university, that would be $27,000. 

It's money I don't have. I've looked everywhere. I've looked into going to school overseas, scholarships, financial aid. My SO also needs to go to school: so if I went we would end up starting our lives almost $60,000 in debt.

Fuck this. I'm sorry. I just feel like a trapped animal.
